from datetime import datetime

# Login to Gmail
pw=None
for x in apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords():
    if x['account_name']=='gmail':
        pw=x['password']
res_gmail=apis.gmail.login(username='chris.mcco@gmail.com', password=pw)
gacc=res_gmail['access_token']

# Fetch inbox threads matching the Spotify verification subject (loop pages)
query='Spotify Account Verficiation Code'
threads=[]
i=0
while True:
    page=apis.gmail.show_inbox_threads(access_token=gacc, query=query, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    print('page', i, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    threads.extend(page)
    i+=1

print('total_threads', len(threads))

# For the matching threads, fetch full content to extract the code
for t in threads:
    tid=t['email_thread_id']
    created=t['created_at']
    read=t['read']
    print('thread_id', tid, 'created_at', created, 'read', read)
    full=apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gacc)
    for e in full['emails']:
        body=e['body']
        # anchor on the label "verification code is:" from the message
        import re
        m=re.search(r"verification code is:\s*([A-Za-z0-9]+)", body, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
        code=m.group(1) if m else None
        print('  email_subject', e['subject'])
        print('  extracted_code', code)

print('Starting payment update...')
# Ensure we have spotify_token
print('have spotify_token', 'spotify_token' in globals() and bool(spotify_token))

# existing spotify payment cards from previous debug
if 'spotify_cards' in globals():
    print('spotify_cards_existing', spotify_cards)
else:
    spotify_cards = apis.spotify.show_payment_cards(access_token=spotify_token)
    print('spotify_cards_existing', spotify_cards)

# Delete any existing Spotify payment cards (especially expired) before adding a valid one
# We'll delete all existing cards to avoid the expired one blocking subscription.
existing_ids = [c['payment_card_id'] for c in spotify_cards] if spotify_cards else []
print('existing_ids_to_delete', existing_ids)
for pid in existing_ids:
    del_res = apis.spotify.delete_payment_card(payment_card_id=pid, access_token=spotify_token)
    print('delete_payment_card_res', pid, del_res)

# Pick a valid payment card from supervisor cards
now = datetime.now()
super_cards = apis.supervisor.show_payment_cards()
print('super_cards_count', len(super_cards))
valid_cards = []
for c in super_cards:
    exp_year=int(c['expiry_year'])
    exp_month=int(c['expiry_month'])
    is_valid=(now.year < exp_year) or (now.year==exp_year and now.month <= exp_month)
    if is_valid:
        valid_cards.append(c)
print('valid_cards', valid_cards)

card = valid_cards[0]
add_res = apis.spotify.add_payment_card(
    card_name=card['card_name'],
    owner_name=card['owner_name'],
    card_number=card['card_number'],
    expiry_year=card['expiry_year'],
    expiry_month=card['expiry_month'],
    cvv_number=card['cvv_number'],
    access_token=spotify_token
)
print('add_payment_card_res', add_res)
payment_card_id = add_res['payment_card_id']

# Subscribe yearly premium
sub_res = apis.spotify.subscribe_premium(payment_card_id=payment_card_id, duration='yearly', access_token=spotify_token)
print('subscribe_res', sub_res)

acct = apis.spotify.show_account(access_token=spotify_token)
print('acct_is_premium', acct.get('is_premium'))

# Fetch premium subscriptions (not paginated? but could. We'll just page through)
subs=[]
i=0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_premium_subscriptions(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=i, page_limit=20)
    print('subs_page', i, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    subs.extend(page)
    i+=1
print('premium_subscriptions_total', len(subs))
print('premium_subscriptions', subs)
